title: Online Clipboard — Share Text Instantly | Webklip
description: Free online clipboard for instant text sharing. No sign-up, real-time sync, automatic expiry. Create a web clipboard in one click.
intro: Copy text on one device and paste it on another — without email, chat apps, or cloud storage accounts.
paragraphs: An online clipboard is a web-based tool that stores text temporarily so you can access it from any browser. Webklip turns any URL into a shared clipboard: paste your content, send the link, and open it on your phone, laptop, or tablet.

Unlike a system clipboard that only works on one machine, a web clipboard syncs in real time. Type on your desktop and see the same text appear on your phone seconds later — then let the clip expire so nothing lingers in a message history.

title: Secure Clipboard — PIN & Encryption | Webklip
description: Secure clipboard with PIN protection or end-to-end encryption. Choose one protect mode, share sensitive text safely, then let it expire.
intro: Share sensitive content with a PIN lock or end-to-end encryption — choose one, then let it disappear automatically.
paragraphs: A secure clipboard needs more than a random URL. In Protect settings, pick PIN or E2E — not both. A PIN gates access on the server so only people who know the code can open the clip; PINs are hashed before saving, never stored in plain text.

Prefer zero-knowledge storage? Choose E2E instead: content is encrypted in the browser before upload, and the key stays in the URL fragment. Pair either mode with a short TTL or burn-after-read so secrets are deleted when you are done. Public Klipwall listings cannot use PIN, E2E, or burn-after-read.
benefits: Choose PIN or E2E — mutually exclusive protect modes
PIN hashed on the server, or browser-side E2E with the key in the URL
Burn after read for single-use secrets
Automatic deletion after expiry
useCases: Send a temporary password to a colleague
Share an API key for a one-time setup
Transfer sensitive notes that should not persist

title: End-to-End Encrypted Clipboard | Webklip
description: End-to-end encrypted clipboard. Content encrypted in your browser — the server never sees plaintext.
intro: Encrypt your content in the browser before it leaves your device. Only people with the key can read it.
paragraphs: Standard clipboard sharing trusts the server with your content. With end-to-end encryption, text is encrypted in your browser before upload — the server stores ciphertext only and cannot read your data even if compelled.

The decryption key lives in the URL fragment (after #), which browsers never send to the server. Share the full URL including the key; recipients decrypt locally in their browser. E2E replaces PIN protection — choose one protect mode in Settings.
benefits: Encryption happens in your browser before upload
Server stores ciphertext only — no plaintext access
Decryption key stays in the URL fragment
Choose E2E instead of a PIN; combine with auto-expiry or burn-after-read
useCases: Share credentials that the server cannot read
